D021-D017_h001.question: It’s been, well, a while now, maybe eight or nine months since I really started feeling… different. D021-D017_h002.question:
"Thanks for seeing me, Doc. Honestly, I'm not really sure why I'm here. My foreman, he just kept hounding me, said I'm looking too thin. I really do watch what I eat. Sometimes, it’s just a few bites here and there, just to get by. I mean, what's wrong with wanting to be lean? I check my weight a lot, it’s just a habit really, just to make sure I’m staying where I need to be. If it goes up even a little bit, it’s like, ‘ah man, now I gotta really tighten things up.’ It just makes me anxious, thinking about going backward.     B. Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Hyperactive/Impulsive Presentation)
